items.t: Crown Castle vs. American Tower: Higher Yield or Better Dividend Growth
items.sum: One tower REIT hands retirees a bigger check today, while the other has a dividend with room to grow. Before choosing, weigh the payout cut, the debt load, and a trough year that both companies are betting on.

items.t: Deutsche Bank Names Top North America Telecom Services Stock
items.sum: Investing.com -- Deutsche Bank has initiated coverage on the U.S. tower sector with a neutral outlook for the next 12 months, naming American Tower as its top pick despite near-term headwinds facing the industry. The firm notes that while long-term fundamentals remain constructive, U.S. wireless network investment is experiencing a relative trough expected to continue through 2027.

items.t: 3 Cell Tower REITs Positioned to Profit as Wireless Data Demand Quadruples
items.sum: One tower REIT slashed its dividend last year, another has raised its payout every year since 2019, and a third yields the most with the least cushion. Which one deserves your income dollars before the next spectrum auction?
